Related to #157; does not close it. Merge through the protected singleton main queue. No ruleset, token-permission, production release or tag changes.

Forward-porting release enforcement to prerelease/0.9.x exposed four CLI test failures caused by assumptions that the repository package is always stable 0.8.1. Derive the selected CLI channel, matching tag and expected workflow output from the actual package version; retain explicit odd/even fixtures and both accepted/rejected CLI channel checks. Production scripts and product files are unchanged.

Validation: the original 0.9.0 authority-sync suite recorded 239 passing and five failures (four CLI assumptions and one missing recovery changelog). The corrected CLI tests pass on stable 0.8.1 (18 tests) and the same files plus published recovery notes pass on prerelease 0.9.0 (26 tests). Compilation, lint and diff checks pass. PR #164 will copy these authority blobs only after this PR merges and preserve published 0.8.1 recovery notes. Related to #157; this does not close the rollout issue.

This policy-only correction must use the protected main merge queue. No release or tag is created.
